meta.purpose: Contract + golden examples for Agentic CDD Databook data-quality parity/verification

dropped.example_reason: value is orders of magnitude below the series centre - a ratio, not the amount

conflict.default_rule: most documents stating it, then that source's coverage of this metric, then how much of the fact base the source supplies, then how plainly the caption names the metric, then the most central value

representative_items.reason: value is orders of magnitude below the series centre - a ratio, not the amount
representative_items.verify: NRR/ratio-like numbers must not enter Revenue series; surface as dropped with reason

representative_items.rule: most documents stating it, then that source's coverage of this metric, then how much of the fact base the source supplies, then how plainly the caption names the metric, then the most central value
representative_items.verify: Same metric+year, different docs → Sources disagree; UI must show candidates + chosen + allow override
Multiple values for same metric inside one file (segment rows) must conflict within-document
representative_items.note: candidates omitted for brevity; live payload had 5 values 5/9/24/28/34

representative_items.verify: CRITICAL anti-goal: auto-chooser must NOT pick Units Sold (320) as Revenue when real Revenue candidates exist; require human review / better metric-identity matching

observed_failure_modes_for_our_build: Metric identity pollution: Units Sold / NRR / GRR / Churn appear as Revenue candidates
Unit/currency confusion: captions say Revenue (INR Cr) but values look like rupees-as-float (1.9e9) and metric sometimes named net_revenue_usd_m
Heuristic auto-choose can select wrong governing value (320 Units Sold over 31.4B/49B Revenue)
Duplicate conflict items across repeated extract passes inflate needs_review (77 items, many near-duplicates)
dropped series outliers (ratio vs amount) are valuable — keep
acceptance_checks_when_we_build: conflict items always include metric, fiscal_year, candidates[], chosen, scope, rule
dropped items always include reason + detail.metric/fiscal_year/value
Test2-like pack surfaces Exec Summary vs Commercial DD Revenue disagreements
UI maps conflict → Sources disagree flag; dropped/outlier → Not landed or Assumption triage
User can override chosen candidate; decision audited (correct/vouch) — auto-chosen never silent-final
Metric matching requires caption/metric family gates so Units Sold cannot win a Revenue conflict
